mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies near Badger Prairie County Park, a waxing crescent moon, and an overnight low of 36 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to ensure year-round accessibility, with a public information meeting scheduled for December 8 at the Senior Center.

We have a busy schedule ahead, including Yoga at Insight Wellness and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee both happening today, plus trivia events tomorrow and live music at Bailey's Run on Thursday.
In a recent report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I offence after finding him in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Culver's has wrapped up its service for the night, but be sure to head over when they open tomorrow at 10:00 AM to enjoy tomorrow's flavor of the day, which is Devil's Food Cake.
